title: The Bond Market’s Surprising Take on the AI Trade
title_zh: 債市對 AI 交易出人意料的看法
subtitle: 債市對 AI 交易出人意料的看法
author: Telis Demos

sentences.en: The AI trade appears to be back on Thursday as markets get ready to celebrate the Anthropic debut.
sentences.zh: 週四 AI 交易似乎回來了，市場正準備慶祝 Anthropic 掛牌。

sentences.en: Stocks were buoyed by the news, with Nasdaq futures up 2% in premarket trading.
sentences.zh: 股市受這個消息提振，那斯達克期貨在盤前交易上漲 2%。

sentences.en: Bonds are sending a different signal.
sentences.zh: 債券釋放的卻是不同的訊號。

sentences.en: Over the past week or so, the bond market—reputed to obsess about what can go wrong—seemed to get a little more comfortable with AI-related risks.
sentences.zh: 過去一週左右，以老是擔心會出什麼差錯而聞名的債市，似乎對 AI 相關風險稍微放心了一些。

sentences.en: This means investors were demanding less extra return to compensate for the risks of holding that debt.
sentences.zh: 這代表投資人為了彌補持有這些債務的風險，所要求的額外報酬變少了。

sentences.en: That move has been led by data-center bonds with high-yield “junk” ratings.
sentences.zh: 帶動這波走勢的是評級為高收益「垃圾級」的資料中心債券。
所以投資人可說一點也不樂觀。

sentences.en: Yet the logic of the past week or two appears to be that if future data-center construction is becoming dicier, data centers that do get built can become more valuable.
sentences.zh: 不過過去一兩週的邏輯似乎是：如果未來資料中心的興建變得更沒把握，那些真的蓋起來的資料中心就會變得更有價值。

sentences.en: And if AI companies have to focus more on maximizing today’s revenues, that could favor bonds over stocks, which are priced for future growth.
sentences.zh: 而如果 AI 公司必須更專注於把眼前的營收最大化，那可能對債券比對股票有利，因為股票的價格反映的是未來成長。

sentences.en: Bonds may also take heart from Nvidia’s third-quarter earnings Tuesday, which showed the company has kept up its strong performance.
sentences.zh: 債市也可能從輝達週二公布的第三季財報得到鼓舞，財報顯示公司持續表現強勁。

sentences.en: But here’s the rub: Many investors won’t have full exposure to the AI bond market.
sentences.zh: 但問題來了：許多投資人並沒有完整參與 AI 債券市場。

sentences.en: A lot of passive-index investors may be effectively underweight data-center financing bonds.
sentences.zh: 許多被動指數投資人實際上可能是減碼（低配）資料中心融資債券的。

vocab.zh: 首次亮相；（股票）掛牌首日
vocab.usage: trading debut 上市首日交易；make a debut 首次登場
vocab.example: The singer made her debut at 18.
vocab.example_zh: 這位歌手 18 歲出道。

vocab.usage: 多用被動：be buoyed by… 受…提振；名詞 buoy 是「浮標」
vocab.example: Sales were buoyed by strong holiday demand.
vocab.example_zh: 銷售受到假期強勁需求的提振。

vocab.usage: premarket trading 盤前交易；after-hours trading 盤後交易
vocab.example: The stock rose 5% in premarket trading.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔股票盤前上漲 5%。

vocab.usage: send a signal 發出訊號；a strong / clear signal
vocab.example: The price drop is a warning signal.
vocab.example_zh: 價格下跌是一個警訊。

vocab.usage: obsess about / over… 對…念念不忘；形容詞 obsessed
vocab.example: Don't obsess about small mistakes.
vocab.example_zh: 別一直糾結小錯誤。

vocab.usage: bond yield 債券殖利率；high-yield bond 高收益債（垃圾債）；動詞 yield＝產生
vocab.example: Bond yields rose this week.
vocab.example_zh: 本週債券殖利率上升。

vocab.usage: compensate for + 名詞（compensate for the loss）；名詞 compensation 薪酬／賠償
vocab.example: The company will compensate customers for the delay.
vocab.example_zh: 公司會為延誤補償客戶。

vocab.usage: junk bond 垃圾債＝high-yield bond；junk rating 垃圾級評等
vocab.example: Junk bonds pay higher interest.
vocab.example_zh: 垃圾債付的利息比較高。

vocab.usage: 正式用語；hardly sanguine 一點也不樂觀；be sanguine about…
vocab.example: Analysts are not sanguine about the economy.
vocab.example_zh: 分析師對經濟並不樂觀。

vocab.usage: 口語；比較級 dicier；＝risky / uncertain
vocab.example: The weather looks dicey for the trip.
vocab.example_zh: 旅行的天氣看起來不太妙。

vocab.usage: maximize profits / revenue / efficiency；反義 minimize
vocab.example: We want to maximize our sales this quarter.
vocab.example_zh: 我們想把這一季的業績衝到最高。

vocab.usage: favor A over B 偏好 A 勝過 B；英式拼法 favour
vocab.example: The new rules favor small businesses.
vocab.example_zh: 新規定對小型企業有利。

vocab.usage: take heart from… 從…得到鼓舞
vocab.example: Workers took heart from the good news.
vocab.example_zh: 員工因為好消息而受到鼓舞。

vocab.usage: exposure to + 資產（exposure to tech stocks 持有科技股的部位）
vocab.example: The fund has little exposure to China.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔基金對中國的曝險很少。

vocab.zh: 減碼的；低配的（持有比例低於指標）
vocab.usage: 反義 overweight 加碼；be underweight + 資產
vocab.example: The fund is underweight bank stocks.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔基金減碼銀行股。

vocab.usage: qualified investors 合格投資人；be qualified for a job 符合職缺資格
vocab.example: Only qualified applicants will be contacted.
vocab.example_zh: 只有符合資格的應徵者會被通知。

vocab.usage: 常用複數；securities firm 證券公司
vocab.example: He works for a securities firm.
vocab.example_zh: 他在一家證券公司工作。

vocab.usage: rumors / fears swirling around… 圍繞…的傳言四起
vocab.example: Rumors are swirling around the CEO.
vocab.example_zh: 關於執行長的傳言四起。

vocab.usage: 動詞 diversify；diversify your portfolio 分散投資組合
vocab.example: Diversification can reduce risk.
vocab.example_zh: 分散投資可以降低風險。

vocab.usage: seek out opportunities / customers 主動找機會／客戶
vocab.example: Good managers seek out new ideas.
vocab.example_zh: 好的主管會主動尋找新點子。
